title: A vegan world
text: A vegan world begins with one shift, not a thousand fixes. Animals stop being property, morally and legally. That is the whole change. The end of factory farming, the end of the slaughterhouse, the end of the testing lab: these are not separate goals. They are downstream effects of that one foundational shift. Welfarism works the opposite way. It treats every cruelty as its own problem to be managed, a bigger cage here, a humane stun there, and the work never ends, because the status of animals as things we own and use is left untouched. Let us be honest about the limits. A vegan world does not end all suffering. Animals will still die in the wild. What ends is regarding animals as ours to use, whether on an industrial scale or in a single back garden. This is not idealism. It is just the logic.
